candidates.name: Unison
candidates.reason: Three deterministic canaries passed on 2026-10-15: exact search for Give It Up / Don Toliver, direct ID 31, and direct ID 1494 Love Never Felt So Good / Michael Jackson. Direct reads retained raw TTML; parsed tracks have 341/441 cues including explicit line and positioned word cues. Source attribution is https://unison.boidu.dev; individual lyric-text rights remain unverified and no ODbL claim is made.

candidates.name: Start Jamming
candidates.reason: Documented public read API; search has object/array response variants, index is keyed by ID, and artist can be absent. Chords use normalized measure arrays; cannot claim lyric-aligned chords. Requires a supported adapter and real canaries before activation. Primary API docs returned HTTP 200 on 2026-10-16 at 06:03:15 UTC. Agent requests to /api/songs/* must include for=agent, honor ETags and preserve canonical IDs/URLs. Agent responses omit license; licensing must not be inferred. Permitted reuse/attribution evidence and two independent live extraction canaries remain pending.

candidates.name: Lyrica
candidates.reason: Open-source self-hostable aggregator; repository documentation alone does not establish a supported public upstream service or independent data coverage. Investigate deployment/access requirements before proposing activation.

candidates.name: Ukrainian Wikisource
candidates.reason: On 2026-10-16 at 06:04:01 UTC, public MediaWiki siteinfo returned Ukrainian Wikisource (uk) and site CC BY-SA 4.0 rights metadata. At 06:04:12 UTC, the Ukrainian folk songs category returned five title metadata entries and continuation. This proves regional catalog metadata access only; no lyric extraction canaries were run. Overlap with existing sources is unmeasured. Defer pending per-work copyright/provenance review, attribution/share-alike handling, compatible identity/search adapter, two independent live extraction canaries and claimed capability coverage. Site rights metadata alone does not clear every work.
